what_this_is: EXACT reproducible spec of the best Wave-3 stack (S1_gate5d, dLL +1.958m, verdict HOLD — v6 stands; spec published for reimplementation/telemetry purposes, NOT as a promotion). A spec-level reimplementation needs nothing beyond this file plus the named data artifacts.
verdict_context: S1 did NOT clear the promotion gate (G1/G2/G3 all fail). It is the only stack with positive holdout dLL and its gain is concentrated exactly where preregistered (gated thin-data rows +13.39m on n=178).

data_recipe.frame: testing_lab/v8/data/frame_expanded/series.csv, sha256 ff772d417b714844aa1b11426d8c04917e1b2848c9c8df811cd9988694d55142 (verify vs crn.json frame_expanded before use; abort on mismatch)
data_recipe.game_corpus: engine.Engine().games on the expanded registry (2023-2026 incl. corpus additions); per-map rows; MapNum=='all' aggregate rows excluded upstream

branch_A_v6_default.model: v6 champion (walk-forward Massey), replayed on the expanded frame
branch_A_v6_default.decay: games-counted, consistency-typed: HL 20 map-games if result consistent with team's trailing HL16 decayed map winrate (>=0.5 won / <0.5 lost), else HL 12
branch_A_v6_default.weights: champ x2 on event_id fullmatch YYYY_champions only; playoffs/grand_final x1.6; year-boundary roster continuity (engine roster_mode 'year')
branch_A_v6_default.solve: ridge 0.5 + region-prior ridge 1.5 toward previous-day region means; sum-zero constraint

branch_B_5d_statespace.model: per-team Kalman analog (bias-h3 5d roster-typed), strict-day walk-forward
branch_B_5d_statespace.R_definition: Var(y) over train-era maps (date <= 2024-12-31); all reported quantities depend only on q/R and are invariant to this choice
branch_B_5d_statespace.obs_noise_per_game: R_i = R / w_i with w_i = (2.0 if YYYY_champions exact-shape else 1.0) * (1.6 if stage in {playoffs, grand_final} else 1.0)
branch_B_5d_statespace.roster_cell_rule: matches_since_change at the game's match (lineups-agent rule: walk back through the org's strictly-earlier match sequence while the fielded 5-lineup is identical; missing lineup -> stable cell). Table: scratch/bias_h3/lineup_topup.csv (0/3466 mismatches vs lineups agent)
branch_B_5d_statespace.p_series: GH-20 Gauss-Hermite integral of series form over N(mu_delta, v_A+v_B), normalized weights
branch_B_5d_statespace.probability_vector: scratch/bias_h3/model_probs.npz p_ss_5d (holdout LL 0.647483); pre-match variances vw_5d/vl_5d

gate.rule: use branch B iff neff_min < 12 else branch A
gate.neff_min: min(R/v_w, R/v_l) with the SAME R constant as branch B and v = pre-match per-team posterior variance from the 5d filter
gate.threshold_provenance: only 5d hard gate beating v6 on TRAIN (h3_ensemble.json train_table: 0.646927 vs v6 0.648226); preregistered in preregister.compose.md before scoring

no_other_free_parameters: S1 introduces zero new fitted constants; every number above is a Wave-2 train-side fit from the named artifacts. No solve constant changed, so no beta refit was owed (wave2_common scale-bound rule).
judging_record: stats/compose_stacks.json S1_gate5d; gate clauses in stats/compose_gate.json; one-shot scoring sentinel scratch/compose/SCORED
